Label.text: Editor widgets from GUI.Toolkit. A tool bar's buttons name commands, as menu items and shortcuts do: one command greys its button, its row in a menu and its keys together, and a tooltip says the keys and why a command is disabled. What does not fit goes into the menu at the bar's end. A status bar holds items in a start and an end zone and a message; right-click it to hide or show the items with a title.
Tool bars and a status bar
Save, Undo and Redo start disabled: hover them for why. Make a change to enable them. Ctrl+N, Ctrl+O, Ctrl+S, Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y run them while the focus is in this frame.
ToolBar, ToolButton, ToolMenuButton (a drop-down, or split) and StatusBar (GUI.Toolkit) over the core's commands and keymap; the default sheet styles them through the theme's tokens.

Three lamps, an application's own objects: edit one, or all three, where values that differ show as mixed (each part of a Float3 on its own). Drag across a number to scrub it (Escape gives the scrub up), drag the line between the names and the values, fold the categories, and search by name or path. Each edit is one step of Undo, however long its drag. Tags and Effects are lists: Add (a menu of types for Effects), drag an element's grip, or right-click it. A bar and a bold name mark what differs from how the lamp started; right-click to revert it, or to copy a value and paste it onto another of its shape. The cone shows only when every lamp edited is a spot; the falloff asks for an editor that does not exist yet.

PropertyGrid (GUI.Toolkit) over an IPropertySource the page keeps, which copies with the engine's XmlSerializer; its editors are the core's check box, number field, text field and combo box, a list of check boxes for flags, a number field per part for Float2 and Float3, and a list's count and Add.

Two camera rigs declared with core reflection and nothing written for the grid: ReflectedPropertySource reads their properties and attributes. The field of view shows for a perspective projection, the orthographic size for an orthographic one; the layers are flags by an attribute; the rotation is a Quaternion shown in Euler degrees; the background is a Color (click the swatch for the picker: a drag previews, closing commits, Escape gives it up); the glow is an HDR colour, its intensity in exposure stops. Effects add by type. Changed values are marked against the type's defaults; copying uses the engine's XmlSerializer, and Undo steps back through the source's changes.
ReflectedPropertySource (GUI.Toolkit) over sandbox::CameraRig, its text format the engine's XmlSerializer, its changes kept by the page for Undo.
